A '''flen''' was a particularly strong beast of burden found on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE Ithor">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> Some Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|males]] had "Flen" as a given name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The flen was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
